### The House of God
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/house-god
Passage: Genesis 28:18-22
Points:
- Jacob set up and anointed his stone pillow as a memorial pillar to commemorate meeting God at Bethel.
- Jacob made a vow pledging his devotion, though it was conditionally framed around his personal safety and provision.
- While Jacob's bargaining revealed an immature faith, God in His grace patiently calls and uses imperfect people.
- Vows in worship should reflect grateful covenant renewal and submission, rather than attempts to barter with God.
